title: Minigame: A7.7 Encirclement

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the D5.34 claim's Encirclement increment (the Rules-first plan, section 7): the A7.7 and A7.71 examples on board 3, two positions: a Russian squad in [T3] fired on by German squads, and a Russian squad in [T4] fired on by a German fire group, their facts entered by hand.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): whether attacks seal an Encirclement, and what being Encircled does, asked on the Rule Workbench.

introduction: A7.7 Encirclement: German squads fire on a Russian squad in [T3] from [U2] and [S5], and, in the A7.71 example's position, a four-hex German fire group in [T3]-[U4]-[U5]-[T5] fires on a Russian squad in [T4].

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
